summary: Frontend-only testing of sidebar nav reorder feature in Layout.jsx. All acceptance criteria PASS: drag handle visibility on hover, drag-and-drop reorder, per-user localStorage persistence under key `stockmgmt:nav_order:v1:<userId>`, cross-session persistence (reload), reset button restores default code order, label-click navigation still works, drag handle does not navigate, profile/sign-out preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx is 263 lines — within limits, single-responsibility, clean.
useEffect dependency on `visibleItems.length` (eslint-disabled) is acceptable but a content-based key (e.g. join of tos) would be more correct if a same-length set of items swapped permissions.
applyOrder gracefully appends NEW nav items added in code to end of saved order — good forward-compat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested with Playwright via browser_automation. Verified initial order (Dashboard, Stock Master, Locations, Stock In, Stock Out, Stock Transfer, Stock Summary, Transactions, Low Stock, Users), dragged stock-master handle onto stock-out row → resulted in [/, /locations, /stock-in, /stock-out, /stock-master, /stock-transfer, ...]. localStorage key written correctly under user.id (a19fd59b-7db5-4865-b541-4ed57f62d782 for admin). Reload preserved order. Reset button restored default and persisted to localStorage. Drag handle opacity = 0 by default and 1 on row hover (group-hover Tailwind works). Label click on /stock-master correctly navigated. Profile click navigated to /profile. NotificationBell rendered.
